item.title: We accept overall election outcome: Jamaat Ameer

item.title: BD to import $15b energy products from US

item.title: Ramadan likely to begin on Feb 19
item.description: The holy month of Ramadan is expected to start on February 19, subject to moon sighting, the Islamic Foundation said on Tuesday.Alongside the announcement, the Foundation published the official schedule for Sehri and iftar, to be observed throughout the month.These timings will guide Muslims across the country in observing daily fasts during Ramadan, one of the most significant months in the Islamic calendar.AM

item.title: Pak govt to shift Imran Khan to hospital, form medical board
item.description: The Pakistan government has announced that jailed Imran Khan would be shifted to a hospital for medical treatment and that a medical board would be constituted to examine him, as a protest sit-in by the Tehreek-e-Tahfuz-Ayeen-e-Pakistan (TTAP) outside Parliament entered its second day.Officials said the decision was taken in light of concerns over the former premier’s deteriorating health, particularly reports regarding serious vision loss in his right eye. item.title: Not Bangabhaban, oath ceremony to be held at South Plaza

item.title: Australia unveils initial US$2.8 billion for new nuclear subs facility

item.title: Preparing to form shadow cabinet: Asif Mahmud
item.description: National Citizen Party (NCP) spokesperson Asif Mahmud Sajib Bhuiyan has said they are preparingto form a shadow cabinet.In a Facebook post on Sunday morning (February 15), he stated that the shadow cabinet will function as a watchdog to ensure transparency and accountability in government operations.
